descriptionChirho: Noun קָלִי (qali) meaning 'roasted grain' or 'parched grain,' a staple food prepared by roasting fresh ears of wheat or barley. The two clusters differ only in definiteness (with/without article) and conjunction. Eng 'roasted grain / the parched grain,' Spa 'y grano tostado / grano tostado,' Hin 'भुना हुआ अनाज,' Arb 'وَفَريكًا / الفَرِيكِ,' Kor '볶은 곡식,' Swa 'nafaka iliyokaangwa.' All occurrences (Ruth 2:14; 1 Sam 17:17, 25:18; 2 Sam 17:28) refer to the same foodstuff.
